checks.name: unsupported_synthesis
checks.detail: Claim-25 says the 2026-11-03 findings describe partial improvement in mood, affect, sleep and meal intake. The 2026-11-03 note (f13) documents 'Partial improvement' as a general assessment, and separately records 'Depressed mood, slightly brighter affect' (f12), 'Slept 5 hours' and 'Ate 50% of meals' (f16). The note does not state that mood or sleep improved, so the improvement attribution for mood and sleep is not supported by the quoted evidence.

checks.name: quote_fidelity
checks.detail: Claim-14 drops the quotation marks around the patient's words 'I still want to die' (f9), turning direct speech into narration. Claim-8 is labeled direct_quote but its text is a paraphrase-level restatement of the note sentence and is not presented as a quotation. Clinician should confirm the wording and sourceKind.

checks.name: causal_wording
checks.detail: Claim-13 states the family meeting had not been held 'because' the sibling was unavailable. The 2026-11-03 note (f24) records both facts in one sentence but does not state the causal link. Clinician should confirm whether the causal wording is supported.

checks.name: requested_authorized_period_distinction
checks.detail: The draft contains no requested or authorized period claims. Code adds these after review, so their absence is not a defect here.

checks.name: claim_quote_support_review
checks.detail: Claims 1-7, 9-12, 15-24 are consistent with the quoted source text for their supplied fact IDs, including dates and numbers, and no new facts or dates were introduced.
